title: India to Host BWF World Championships 2026 Mascot Competition
indian_angle: India is hosting the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, making the mascot competition a key national initiative.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a mascot competition for the BWF World Championships 2026, which India is set to host.

title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released by BAI
indian_angle: The minutes provide insight into the selection process for India's junior badminton talent, directly impacting future national representation.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the minutes from its recent Junior Selection Committee meeting, outlining decisions regarding young players.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Welfare
indian_angle: The formation of an Athletes Committee by BAI signifies a step towards better representation and support for Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of a new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a stronger voice in the sport's governance and welfare.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Begins
indian_angle: This camp at NCE Guwahati is vital for preparing India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's junior talent.

title: BAI Launches Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course aims to uplift the standard of badminton coaching across India, fostering future champions.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has initiated a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur, running from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The new 3x15 scoring system will be implemented in Indian domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
